portfolio-dash 0.1.29 Change Manual

This manual gives all the changes on the branch feat/corporate-actions that are not in the production version v0.1.28. It tells you what each change does, why the team made it, and how you use it.

Effectivity, fromv0.1.28 · 734833b · 2026-08-09 (the production version)
Effectivity, tofeat/corporate-actions · 1ae3ce5 · 2026-10-03. The product code is d9f1c68; the later commits change documents and tests only.
Release name0.1.29 (not cut yet; the what's-new catalog already uses this number)
Scope168 commits · 805 files · +155,914 / −5,567 lines · 466 change items
Test statusFunctional-test manual closed on d9f1c68, three parties signed (2026-10-03): 120 cases, PASS 119, N/A 1; 93 defects, 0 open.
Writing standardASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English (writing rules). Code identifiers, file paths and on-screen Chinese labels stay as they are.

1Introduction

1.1 Purpose

Use this manual before you decide to deploy the branch to the production site. The manual lists each new function, each change and each correction. For each item, it gives the reason, the procedure to use the function, and the code that changed.

1.2 Scope

The manual covers all 168 commits from v0.1.28 to 1ae3ce5. The source of the items is the [Unreleased] section of CHANGELOG.md (3,406 lines). The interfaces, the database changes, the commit register and the file register come directly from git and from the database schema. Part 9 and the appendices are therefore complete lists.

1.3 How to read an item

Each item has an identifier, a type, a title and a date. The identifier has three parts: the type code, the area code and a number, for example F-CASH-004. The text gives the function first, then the reason. A CAUTION comes before the procedure that it applies to.

Some functions have two items: one for the owner's ruling and one for the implementation, or one for the first version and one for a later correction. The later item names the earlier one in its refs.

TypeCodeMeaning
New functionNA function, page, control, report, setting, job or route that v0.1.28 does not have.
ChangeCA change to a function that v0.1.28 has: a rule, a formula, a figure, a default, wording or layout.
CorrectionFThe correction of a defect. The reason field gives the symptom and the cause.
Known limitationLA limitation that the team recorded and did not correct, with the reason.

The impact chips tell you what the change touches:

ImpactMeaning
figuresA figure of record (cost, P&L, return, XIRR, cash balance, fee or tax) can show a different value for the same ledger.
dataThe change writes, migrates or adds stored data or schema.
uiThe user sees a different page, label, message or control.
apiAn /api route or its JSON shape is new or different.
configA setting, a default or a seeded configuration is new or different.
internalNo visible effect: a refactor, a guard or a test.

1.4 Conventions

  • CAUTION tells you about a risk to data or to a figure of record. This manual has no WARNING, because no change is a risk to persons.
  • NOTE gives information. It does not give an instruction.
  • On-screen text stays in Chinese inside 「」, with an English meaning in parentheses at its first use in an item. A message that the system shows is quoted exactly.
  • “The system” is the application. “The user” is the person who uses it. “The owner” is the person who makes the rulings.
  • The manual does not give host names, addresses or credentials. It uses “the demo site” and “the production site”.
NOTE

Sub-agents wrote the item text from the CHANGELOG to the ASD-STE100 writing rules, and the developer reviewed it. A certified STE checker did not examine the text. The commit subjects in Appendix A are quoted from git and do not follow STE.

5.1 Ledger and cost basis 2

N-LEDGER-001 New function 2026-09-30

The data centre shows a read-only list of ledger edits and deletes

The 「資料中心」 (Data centre) page has a 「帳本操作稽核」 (Ledger operation audit) panel with data from GET /api/ledger-audit. The panel is a read-only list on pages: the time, the ledger, the row, 「編輯／刪除」 (edit or delete), and the old values as labelled fields. The list shows accounts by their display names. The 「匯出中心」 (Export centre) has the export 「帳本操作稽核 CSV」 of the full table.

ReasonBefore the change, the system wrote the ledger_audit table but had no reader for it.

Procedure
  1. Open the 「資料中心」 (Data centre) page.
  2. Find the 「帳本操作稽核」 (Ledger operation audit) panel.

ResultThe panel shows each edit and delete of ledger data, with the values before the change.

N-LEDGER-002 New function 2026-08-13

A US DRIP account accepts plain cash dividends

The dividend model drip_us accepts CASH rows as well as DRIP rows. A CASH row reduces adjusted_total like every other cash dividend, so the accounting does not change. The phase-1 oracle calculates such a position again and agrees with the system.

ReasonThe same US position pays cash in some quarters and reinvests in others, and the system rejected every cash payout as dividend_type_mismatch.

5.2 Corporate actions and price basis 8

N-CORP-001 New function 2026-09-25

A script removes orphan SPINOFF seed prices

scripts/clean_orphan_seed_prices.py does a dry run by default. With --apply --reason, it makes a backup, deletes each row with a ledger_audit before-image, and writes one action_log summary. With --backfill, it fetches the history of the affected symbols again. StoredCorporateAction.owned_seed_slot() decides who owns a seed, so the script and the delete, undo, and re-date doors agree.

ReasonBefore the change, the system had no tool to remove a SPINOFF seed price that no corporate action owns. The rule that decides who owns a seed was in the ledgers router.

CAUTION

Make sure that you read the dry run before you use --apply. The script deletes price rows, and only the backup and the ledger_audit before-images keep the old values.

Procedure
  1. Run scripts/clean_orphan_seed_prices.py without options to do a dry run.
  2. Read the list of orphan seed rows.
  3. If you must delete the rows, run the script with --apply --reason and a reason.

ResultThe script deletes the orphan rows and records each row in ledger_audit.

N-CORP-002 New function 2026-09-06

A spinoff child tells which parent gave its payback dividends

Holdings carry three new fields: payback_from_symbol, payback_carried_dividends and payback_own_dividends. The payback progress of a spinoff child now tells that the dividends come from the parent. The label shows on the homepage chip, the dividend strip, the drawer, the CSV export and the LLM variable. The system clears the label after a full exit, the end of a short leg, an oversell or an EXCHANGE out.

ReasonBefore the change, KEMG showed a payback progress of 12.48%, the same value as its parent KEMB. KEMG had never paid a dividend, and nothing told the user that the ratio came from the parent. The owner approved D21 on 2026-08-09, but the system had no code for it.

Procedure
  1. Open the 「儀表板」 (Dashboard) page.
  2. Click the symbol of a spinoff child.
  3. Look at the payback progress in the drawer.

ResultThe drawer tells which parent symbol gave the dividends in the payback progress.

N-CORP-003 New function 2026-08-15

The SPLIT form offers a restated target band as an option

When a SPLIT affects a band set before the split, the system raises the soft issue target_band_predates_split and quotes the restated values. The form shows the 「改為換算後的目標價」 (Change to the converted target prices) checkbox, which is off by default. If the user does not tick it, the system keeps the band that the user typed. The new nullable column instruments.target_set_at dates the band; a split before that date, or a NULL date, raises no issue.

ReasonBefore the change, a band from before the split met a re-expressed price, and target_cross crossed on the split date and after it. Without a date on the band, the one-click broker import would raise the issue on almost every action.

CAUTION

Make sure that you have a backup of the database before you deploy. The system adds the column instruments.target_set_at to the database.

Procedure
  1. Open the 「交易帳本」 (Trade ledger) page.
  2. Click 「＋補登公司行動」 (Add a corporate action).
  3. Select 「同一檔股票，股數變多或變少」 (Same stock, more or fewer shares).
  4. Type a symbol that has a target band, a date and a ratio.
  5. Look at the issue in the preview.

ResultThe preview shows the current and the restated band values and an unticked checkbox.

N-CORP-006 New function 2026-08-10

Stored prices carry a raw close and a split basis

The prices table has the columns close_raw and split_basis, and close is close_raw × split_basis with a 4 dp cap. A stored close is the price as traded on its own date, in the same share terms as the ledger. When the user adds, edits or deletes a split, the system calculates close again from close_raw. Thus the change is idempotent and reversible, and a deleted split restores each price row exactly.

ReasonBefore the change, the system could not change the price basis after a split and then undo that change.

CAUTION

Make sure that you have a backup of the database before the first start. The system adds the close_raw and split_basis columns to the prices table.

The ledger records SPLIT, EXCHANGE and SPINOFF corporate actions

A new corporate-action ledger records a change of the share count without a trade: SPLIT, EXCHANGE and SPINOFF. The replay applies the ratio as two positive integers, and it multiplies first and divides last. The cost basis does not change, and the reconciliation footer of the drawer shows a ＋公司行動 (plus corporate actions) term. One action applies to all accounts that hold the symbol.

ReasonBefore the change, the ledger could not record a share count that changed without a trade. The later sell of a split position tripped the 「賣超」 (Oversell) guard and discarded the cost basis of the position permanently.

CAUTION

Make sure that you type the ratio exactly as the statement shows it. The action changes the share count in every account that holds the symbol.

  5. Select the 「帳戶」 (Account).

N-CASH-001 New function 2026-08-13

Three new cash movement kinds record interest, interest expense and broker fees

The cash ledger accepts INTEREST, INTEREST_EXPENSE and BROKER_FEE, and this change kept them out of XIRR. shared/cash_kinds.py classifies each kind on two axes: the cash direction, and whether it is an FX acquisition. INTEREST is a credit but not an acquisition, so it takes the average rate of the pool. The overdraft guard stays on WITHDRAW only, because a fee is a recorded fact.

ReasonThree places treated every kind except WITHDRAW as a credit. A broker fee would have increased the cash balance and lowered covered_ratio on a pool that lost nothing.

CAUTION

Make sure that you read the later ruling AI-D42 for the XIRR effect. AI-D42 puts INTEREST_EXPENSE and BROKER_FEE into XIRR.

Procedure
  1. Open the 「資金管理」 (Cash management) page.
  2. Click the 「出金入金」 (Withdrawals and deposits) tab.
  3. In 「方向」 (Direction), click 「利息」 (Interest), 「融資利息」 (Interest expense) or 「券商費用」 (Broker fee).
  4. Select the 「帳戶」 (Account).
  5. Type the 「日期」 (Date) and the 「金額」 (Amount).
  6. Click 「確認寫入」 (Confirm and write).

ResultThe system records the cash movement with the selected kind.

A converter changes a Schwab export into the import CSVs

scripts/schwab_convert.py converts a raw Charles Schwab transaction export into the import CSVs of the system, offline. N-ENTRY-007 New function 2026-08-13

The broker converter keeps corporate actions, reinvested shares and old positions

Suppression classifies first and uses arithmetic only as a veto, with the key (date, symbol) and never across symbols. The zero-sum veto covers shares and cash, so a 3-for-1 split (−85 / +255 shares, $0 / $0) does not disappear. The converter calculates a reinvested share count as amount / price, because 125 of 227 real reinvest rows fail quantity × price == amount. Two detectors find positions older than the export: a balance that goes negative, or a first event that is a sell or a reinvest.

ReasonWhen the converter grouped by date alone, it dropped 180 rows of a real 1,375-row export, and 8 were real corporate actions. A 1-for-1 ticker exchange nets to zero in cash and shares, so arithmetic alone cannot tell it from a journal.

broker/reconcile.py adds the dropped groups back leg by leg and calculates each trade again from quantity × price ± fees. An advisory names each row that the system will not write by file:line, for example an option leg.

N-PRICE-005 New function 2026-08-17

Fundamentals come from three key-gated providers, one block per source

yfinance, Finnhub and Alpha Vantage each write their own fundamentals snapshot when the provider is enabled. A provider with no key reports supports() == False, so it writes nothing and raises no error. fundamentals_json keeps one block for each source, and the system never merges or averages values. The prompt tells the model to report different values side by side with their sources.

ReasonBefore the change, fundamentals existed only for TW, so a US card was weaker than a TW card. The real portfolio has many US holdings.

5.6 Returns and dashboard figures 1

N-RETURN-001 New function 2026-08-26

The dashboard compares the portfolio with the same money in an index

portfolio/benchmark_counterfactual.py buys each market index with the reporting-currency flows of the portfolio on their dates and values the units at the last close. /api/dashboard carries the lifetime result in new fields, and the excess is figure B minus the counterfactual, never figure A minus it. A market without an index, for example MY, counts in uncovered_ratio, and the row shows 「部分涵蓋」 (Partial coverage) with the markets left out. If the system cannot calculate the comparison, it sets available to false and gives a reason, never a zero.

ReasonBefore the change, no figure told what the same money in the market index would have earned. Without that anchor, the user could not tell if an XIRR of 15% was good or bad.

CAUTION

Make sure that you compare the 「差額」 row with 「含匯兌總損益」, not with 「資產損益」. If the row shows 「部分涵蓋」, part of the money has no index, and the difference is not a full comparison.

Procedure
  1. Open the 「儀表板」 (Dashboard) page.
  2. Find the 「指數對照」 (Index comparison) card in the KPI band.
  3. Look at the 「同期指數」 (Index, same period) and 「差額」 (Difference) rows.

ResultThe card shows the index return for the same money and dates, and the difference from figure B.

N-STRAT-005 New function 2026-08-21

The rules engine keeps one history row per symbol and date

The new table signal_history stores the full state of the rules engine for each symbol on each price date. The key is (symbol, as_of) on the data date, so a scan on a holiday overwrites the same row. The scan rebuilds each absent historical date through replay, so the depth follows the 5-year price backfill. The daily scan fills the absent dates, and it writes the head row only when the state changes.

ReasonBefore the change, signal_states kept the latest state only, so nobody could see how TechScore changed. Without history, the backtest could not run, and the blueprint did not allow new indicators without it.

An event study measures forward returns after signal changes

portfolio/backtest.py finds rule score-sign changes and TechScore crossings of the current 65/35 state bands. An event study measures what occurs after a signal change

N-STRAT-009 New function 2026-08-20

The event study uses forward windows and sample guards

The event study measures +20, +60 and +120 market days against the unconditional distribution of the same symbol. It uses the local currency and split-re-expressed prices, and it annualizes nothing. If n<8, it answers 「不足以判斷」 (not enough to decide) and gives no numbers. It marks events that overlap, and it excludes and counts right-censored events for each window.

ReasonSmall samples and events that overlap can give results that look reliable but are not.

N-AI-017 New function 2026-08-20

The scoreboard scores volatility predictions over two 30-day windows

A volatility prediction compares the realized volatility of the 30 trading days before the evaluation date and before the creation date. The system uses the split-adjusted series series_in, so a split in the window does not look like a volatility spike. The flat band for this metric is ±5%, not the shared ±0.5%, because noise alone can exceed ±0.5%. If the base volatility is zero or the history is too short, the result is None.

ReasonBefore the change, _measure_actual returned vol_change_pct=None, so no volatility card got a hit or a miss.

The scorecard measures volatility change with its own ±5% band

vol_change_pct equals vol_30d(due) / vol_30d(create) − 1, with fixed windows of 30 market days over split-re-expressed closes. 6.1 Ledger and cost basis 6

C-LEDGER-001 Change 2026-09-25

Each ledger row counts in a valuation from its own date

A valuation as at a day counts only the rows with a date on or before that day. The rule applies to trades, opening inventory, dividends, corporate actions, FX conversions and cash movements. The dashboard, 試算 (what-if), the tax package, the sell hints, the drawer and the stress-audit oracle use the rule. Validation replays still use the whole ledger.

ReasonBefore the change, the system cut only dividends by date (DEF-016). A future-dated buy doubled the holding of today, and a future split doubled a position at the unsplit price. The share count of the sell hint and the action delta in the drawer also read all dates.

CAUTION

Make sure that you read the new figures as a different definition. For a ledger with future-dated rows, holdings, market value, 總報酬 (Total return) and XIRR change for the same ledger.

C-LEDGER-005 Change 2026-08-26

A stock dividend counts from its ex-date if the row has one

The dividends ledger has a new nullable ex_date column, and date now means the payment date. A STOCK dividend (「配股」, stock dividend) with an ex-date adds its shares on the ex-date, but DRIP, CASH and NET keep the payment date. 6.2 Corporate actions and price basis 4

C-CORP-001 Change 2026-08-27

Open, high, and low prices get raw columns as close does

The prices table now has the columns open_raw, high_raw, and low_raw. The system stores each of open, high, and low as cap_4dp(raw × split_basis), and it does not cap the raw value. The split reconcile restates all four prices from their raw values, so a deleted SPLIT restores the row byte-identically. The system never multiplies volume, because it is a count, not a price.

ReasonBefore the change, a row could have a post-split close beside pre-split high and low prices. No function read those columns, but a future candlestick chart would show wrong values. This change supersedes D39b.

CAUTION

Make sure that you back up the database before the deploy. The system adds three columns to the prices table and copies each current value into its raw column.

C-CASH-001 Change 2026-09-30

A trade moves its settled amount, not the raw quantity times price

shared/money.settled_notional gives the settled amount of a trade: TWD drops the part below one dollar, and USD and MYR round the cent half up. The cash pool, cost basis, realized proceeds, XIRR, net invested, FX pool, fee base, drawer 試算 (what-if), and the manual preview use this amount. If the product is already exact in the minor unit, the system uses it as it is, so whole-lot ledgers do not change. Of 29 products of quantity and price, 22 settlements use the helper, and 7 are valuations, a rebalance projection, or tolerance checks.

ReasonBefore the change, every conversion of a trade to money used the raw quantity times price. A buy of 0.5 AAPL at 191.23 took 95.615 USD from the cash pool. TWSE calculates an odd-lot settlement amount without the part below one dollar (since 2024-04-01).

CAUTION

Make sure that you read the new figures as settled amounts. A ledger with fractional or odd-lot trades can show a different cash balance, cost basis, realized P&L, and XIRR after this change. On the demo site, 0 of 56 trades change.

Procedure
  1. Open the 「交易帳本」 (Trade ledger) page.
  2. Select the 「手動交易」 (Manual trade) tab.
  3. Type a trade whose quantity times price has more decimals than the currency allows.
  4. Look at the preview.

ResultThe preview shows the settled amount, for example 95.62 USD for 0.5 AAPL at 191.23.

forecast_tw_rebate(..., *, discount) returns 0 if discount is less than 1. The discount argument is required, so a call without it is a type error. The inbox, the draft hint and the rebalance summary use the new forecast. The script scripts/clean_rebate_snapshots.py made the 8 ruled demo snapshots coherent and wrote one ledger_audit row for each.

Each oversell row in an import needs its own acknowledgement

/api/import/commit takes ack_rows, one acknowledgement for each oversell row. The answer names each row and says 「成本基礎會被永久捨棄」 (the cost basis will be discarded permanently). The CSV, broker and AI doors share the dialog web/import-ack.js, and the system never ticks an oversell row for the user.

ReasonBefore the change, one ack_warnings: true for the whole file let the commit write every oversell row. The acknowledgement for each row was only a convention of the broker page.

CAUTION

  3. Load a CSV file that has an oversell row.

C-PLAT-028 Change

The stress harness reconciles the share count on past dates

The stress harness now seeds a close for each fixture symbol on each day from the first ledger event through ASOF. At a known price, trend.total_value pins the share count, so the harness can assert it on every past day. The closes are as traded on their own date, and a SPLIT change does not re-express them. The new baseline is ops=128 pass=6075 fail=0, up from 5663 passes.

ReasonBefore the change, the harness seeded one close per symbol, dated ASOF, so it skipped every earlier day as incomplete. Thus a defect inside a date window, such as a 配股 (stock dividend) booked on the payment date, was not visible. Measured: with the R6 defect reintroduced in the oracle, the old harness reported fail=0, and the new harness reported fail=53.

F-LEDGER-003 Correction 2026-09-25

Each delete or correction of a ledger row runs the replay guard

The undo of an import batch runs the same replay guard as a delete on a ledger tab. If the undo makes a later sell an oversell (賣超), the system first shows the 「賣超確認」 (oversell confirmation) dialog. The undo deletes row by row, and each row writes a ledger_audit row with the source 「批次復原 #id」 (batch undo #id). The single delete, the set delete and the edit of a corporate action also run the guard, so 14 of 14 doors have it.

Symptom and causeBefore the change, the undo of an import batch deleted all its rows with one SQL statement. A later sell became an oversell with no question and no audit row, but a delete of the same buy on its tab asked first.

CAUTION

Make sure that you read the confirmation dialog before you accept it. An acknowledged oversell discards the cost basis of the position permanently.

Procedure
  1. Open the 「交易帳本」 (Trade ledger) page.
  2. Click the 「CSV 匯入」 (CSV import) tab.
  3. Find the batch in the 「最近匯入」 (Recent imports) list.
  4. Click 「復原」 (Undo) beside the batch.

ResultIf the undo makes a later sell an oversell, the system asks you before it deletes the rows.

F-LEDGER-006 Correction 2026-09-23

Same-day trades replay in the order that the user wrote them

The replay sorts the trades of one day by the ledger id, which is the order of entry. shared/ledger_events.py has one TRADE priority, and BUY and SELL are aliases of it. Opening inventory and corporate actions still come before the trades of the day, and dividends still come after them. The manual preview adds its draft last, and the CSV preview counts a same-day row as cover only if it is above the sell.

Symptom and causeBefore the change, the replay put all buys of a day before all sells. Example: 2884 held 100 @ 9,320, then buy 200@44, sell 100@45 and buy 100@46 on one day. The preview showed realized −1,579.67, but the ledger booked −1,223.00; the entry order gives a cost of 16,713.33, not 17,070.

CAUTION

Make sure that you read the new figures as a different definition. For a day with a sell between buys of the same symbol, cost basis and realized P&L change.

Only a TW sell shows 「無法判定是否為 ETF，賣出稅率待確認」 (Cannot tell if ETF; confirm sell tax rate), because a buy has no TW tax. fees.resolve_etf_flag is the one rule that the manual door and the CSV door both use.

Symptom and causeBefore the change, the auto-registration set is_etf to false, and the fee engine used the registry value as the authority. A TW ETF that the user first entered as a trade got the 現股 (ordinary stock) tax of 0.3%, not the ETF tax of 0.1%. On a NT$110,000 sell, the difference was NT$220, and fee_rule_snapshot recorded tax_rate: 0.003 as an established rate.

CAUTION

Back up the database before you deploy this change. The deploy adds the instruments.etf_flag_unknown column, and the system records all older instruments as known and does not relabel them.

Procedure
  1. If a TW sell shows 「無法判定是否為 ETF，賣出稅率待確認」, open the 「觀察清單」 (Watchlist) page.
  2. Find the row of the symbol.
  3. Click 「編輯」 (Edit).
  4. Select or clear 「此標的為 ETF（影響台股賣出稅率 0.1%）」 (This symbol is an ETF).
  5. Click 「儲存」 (Save).

ResultThe system records your answer and does not show the ETF message for this symbol again.

AI retries and the fallback model work again

_call_provider in shared/llm.py owns the retries, and LiteLLM always gets num_retries=0. F-AI-011 Correction 2026-09-26

The shadow limit counts tasks in their shadow period

max_shadows limits the tasks that are in their shadow period at the same time, and each task holds one slot. The slot becomes free when the system decides, promotes, or archives the shadow version, or when the active version catches up. When the limit is full, the task waits and shows 「影子排隊中（目前 N／上限 M）」 (shadow queue, N of M). Promotion compares the record of each version, not the pooled history.

Symptom and causeBefore the change, max_shadows counted every shadow card that the task ever stored. The first per-symbol batch of 9 ignored the limit of 2, and the system never made a later shadow version. The pooled history let v3 get promotion on the shadow evidence of v2.

Procedure
  1. Open the 「洞察管線」 (Insight pipeline) page.
  2. Click a task to open its drawer.
  3. Look at the 「④ 校正版本鏈」 (calibration version chain) section.

F-AI-021 Correction 2026-09-21

The figure check reads Chinese units of magnitude correctly

The check reads a Chinese magnitude as a prefix (十, 百 or 千) times a base (萬, 億 or 兆), and 萬億 is 兆. 百 alone is never a unit, and a number in parts such as 「1兆1,300億」 is one figure. Upper-case B and T join K and M as units, and one scanner reads both the card and the prompt. On all 176 demo cards, the change cleared exactly four false flags and kept the three ×10 errors and 6883.

Symptom and causeBefore the change, the scale table had 千, 萬 and 億 but no 兆, so 「4.51 兆 USD」 read as 4.51. On 13 new cards, the check flagged six market caps, and four of them were correct.

Advice cards cite their record in the correct unit and cell

signal_backtest_json has a units block with a worked example, and the two templates that cite it state that the values are fractions. The citation rule forbids a card to use the baseline as an event return or to invent a number. scoring.confidence_ceiling calculates the largest consistent confidence once, and backtest_json.confidence_ceiling sends it to the model. calibration_gap_json has a plain-language reading field, and nothing clamps the confidence that the model writes.

Symptom and causeIn the first live run, cards printed fractions as 「+0.1336%」, as +0.0640 USD and as a bare 0.1053. F-SCHED-002 Correction 2026-09-30

The cost of a run is the sum of its usage rows

The system opens llm.usage_tally() around the work of each run, and log_usage adds each usage row to the innermost open tally. The job_runs row records cost_usd and the new columns llm_calls, tokens_in, and tokens_out; NULL means no AI call. The status popover reads this row, and both run lists send the canonical Decimal form. The job_runs CSV has four new spend columns.

Symptom and causeBefore the change, static jobs did not write their spend, so the job_runs row of evaluate_insights #212 showed nothing for $0.0021532. The status popover calculated the spend from a time window, while the run history showed nothing for the same run. An insight run added only the cost of its cards, without retries and without primary models that failed before the fallback.

CAUTION

Make sure that you have a backup of the database before you deploy. The system adds three columns to the job_runs table, and runs from before the change show no spend.

Procedure

  2. Select the 「排程中心」 (Scheduler) tab.

F-PLAT-001 Correction 2026-09-25

A GET request never writes to the database

config_store.ensure_seeded decides the first seed under the write lock, and get_ui_prefs only reads. The system creates every table that a read touches when it starts. The two routes that wrote on every call now read first. A contract test starts a fresh database and calls every GET route while other connections hold the write lock.

Symptom and causeBefore the change, GET /api/ui-prefs sometimes failed with 500 (UNIQUE constraint failed: settings_meta.category), because settings.html sent three requests at the same time. 8.1 Ledger and cost basis 2

L-LEDGER-001 Known limitation 2026-09-06

A future-dated foreign trade still values in the current holdings

The equity side has no date limit, because build_book takes no as_of date. A future-dated foreign trade values in the current holdings, but its cash leg does not.

Why it staysValidation only shows a soft message for a future-dated trade. The fix needs a policy decision, so the round records the limit and does not change it.

Impactinternal
L-LEDGER-002 Known limitation 2026-08-27

The NHI supplementary premium is permanently excluded

The system does not calculate the NHI supplementary premium (二代健保補充保費) on dividends, and the owner excluded it permanently. The term is gone from live code and design documents, but the dated records keep it. The dividend gate does not demand that the gross amount minus the withholding is equal to the net amount. A TW cash dividend can legitimately net less because of levies that the system does not model.

Why it staysBefore the ruling, the item had the status "paused, may return". The system never had a rate, a threshold, or a field for it.

Impactinternal

When the user records a SPLIT, instruments.target_low and target_high keep the values that the user typed. Why it staysAn automatic rewrite cannot be reversed, because the band has no *_raw column. After a 10-for-1 split, a band at 600 can mean 60 for a view about the company, or 600 for a view about the price.

The acceptance gate runs on the simulated corpus, and it passes there and fails on a corpus one action row short. The result proves that the feature accepts the shape of the ledger of the owner. This part comes directly from the code and from the database schema. It is a complete list.

9.1 New API routes (22)

9.5 Dependencies and configuration

pyproject.toml did not change, so the deployment installs no new package. The login back end did not change; only the help text on the login page changed. Existing passwords and sessions stay valid.

9.6 Migration at the first start

The first start of the new version migrates the database in place. The team rehearsed this on a local copy (2026-10-03): a database made by v0.1.28 (734833b), with 3 accounts, 5 prices and 10 FX rates, started on d9f1c68.

  • The start completed. The migrated database and a new d9f1c68 database have the same 57 tables, 0 differences in column definitions, and the same indexes. PRAGMA integrity_check returned ok.
  • The system kept each price and FX row. It filled the new raw price columns. The row counts of the ledgers did not change.
  • 70 GET routes without parameters returned no server error (63 returned 200; 7 returned 400 for a missing required parameter).
  • A second start changed nothing: a line-by-line dump of the database showed 0 differences.
  • Two tables have a different column order, because the migration adds a column at the end. The code reads columns by name, so this has no effect.
NOTE

The rehearsal database had no settings, AI configuration, job history or news rows of the production site. The backup in Part 10 covers that difference.

10Deployment and rollback

CAUTION

Do not start this procedure before the owner gives a clear approval in the conversation. A deployment to the production site is difficult to reverse.

10.1 Effects on the production site

  • Scheduler. The scheduler runs only on the production site. The code of the jobs changed much since v0.1.28 (scheduler/jobs.py +1,053 / −194 lines). Tests cover the success and the failure path of each job, and the team ran each job by hand on the demo site. Look at each run for the first two days.
  • Memory. The host has 964 MB of memory, and swap is in use. The new version uses about the same memory as the demo site. The first dashboard load after a long idle time can take 8 s to 17 s. This is not an error in a figure.
  • AI cost. If the production site has an AI key, the scheduled insight jobs use paid calls. Look at the quota and the threshold.
  • FX history. At the first FX refresh, the system writes the MYR/TWD history again as a rate derived from the two USD rates (source derived:USD). This is the 2026-09-16 ruling. With an empty ledger, no figure changes.
  • Real data. No real ledger row has touched this branch. The first real rows are the last test.

10.2 Make the release

  1. Make sure that the working tree is clean.
  2. Set the version to 0.1.29 in portfolio_dash/__init__.py.
  3. Move the [Unreleased] entries of CHANGELOG.md into a v0.1.29 entry with the real delivery date.
  4. Run grep -c "^## \[v" CHANGELOG.md. Make sure that the count is one more than before.
  5. Update the what's-new catalog and the asset stamps.
  6. Run ruff, mypy --strict, pytest and the e2e batches. Make sure that all of them pass.
  7. Make the tag v0.1.29 on the release commit.

10.3 Deploy to the demo site

  1. Make a backup of the demo database.
  2. Make sure that the backup file is not empty and that PRAGMA integrity_check returns ok.
  3. Deploy the tag to the demo site. Use scripts/vm_exec.py for each command on the host.
  4. Run scripts/verify_live.py <demo URL> --expect-version 0.1.29.
  5. Make sure that all checks pass.
  6. Open the demo URL from a computer outside the host. Make sure that the login page shows.
CAUTION

If a step fails, stop. Do not deploy to the production site while the demo site has an error.

10.4 Deploy to the production site

  1. Make a new backup of the production database in the same session.
  2. Make sure that the backup file is not empty and that PRAGMA integrity_check returns ok.
  3. Count the rows of each ledger table. Record the counts.
  4. Deploy the same tag to the production site. Use scripts/vm_exec.py for each command on the host.
  5. Look at the service log of the first start. Make sure that the migration completes without an error.
  6. Run scripts/verify_live.py <production URL> --expect-version 0.1.29.
  7. Count the rows of each ledger table again. Make sure that the counts agree with step 3.
  8. Open the production URL from a computer outside the host. Make sure that the login page shows.
  9. Ask the owner to log in one time. Make sure that the dashboard shows.
  10. Make sure that the two sites show the same version and the same commit.

10.5 Monitor the first two days

  1. Open 「系統設定」 (Settings) → 「排程中心」 (Scheduler) → 「執行歷史」 (Run history) after each scheduled run.
  2. If a run shows 「失敗」 (failed) or 「部分」 (partial), read its detail.
  3. If the production site has an AI key, open 「系統設定」 → 「AI 與額度」 (AI and quota). Make sure that the quota and the threshold are correct.
  4. Type the first real rows in small batches. Compare the figures with the broker statements.

10.6 Roll back

CAUTION

Make the data safe first. Find the cause after the data is safe. Do not run v0.1.28 on a database that the new version migrated: the rehearsal did not test that direction. Use the backup.

  1. Stop the production service.
  2. Put back the backup of the production database from step 10.4-1.
  3. Set the production checkout to the tag v0.1.28.
  4. Start the service.
  5. Run scripts/verify_live.py <production URL> --expect-version 0.1.28.
  6. Count the rows of each ledger table. Make sure that the counts agree with step 10.4-3.
